scopes.FRAME_LEVEL_FALL_COMPATIBILITY_PROXY_ONL: Frame-level compatibility with historical fall output; not a fall event.
scopes.FRAME_LEVEL_POSTURE_PROXY: Frame-level posture compatibility only; not safety state.
scopes.FRAME_LEVEL_PRESENCE_ONLY: No annotated human in the represented frame; no outside-FOV claim.
scopes.NOT_SAFETY_GROUND_TRUTH: Cannot establish worker safety, injury, unconsciousness, or emergency.
scopes.NOT_TEMPORAL_EVENT_GROUND_TRUTH: Cannot support transition, onset, impact, end, or post-fall timing.
